name: pta-browser-plugin
description: 帮助学生完成 PTA 题目的浏览器插件（Chrome / Firefox）

scripts.build: npm run fetch-engine && npm run typecheck && npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.build:chrome: ENTRY=background TARGET=chrome vite build && ENTRY=content TARGET=chrome vite build
scripts.build:firefox: ENTRY=background TARGET=firefox vite build && ENTRY=content TARGET=firefox vite build
scripts.package: npm run package:chrome && npm run package:firefox
scripts.test: node scripts/test-typist.mjs && node scripts/test-diff.mjs && node scripts/test-pta-tools.mjs && node scripts/test-compile.mjs && node scripts/test-deepseek.mjs && node scripts/test-background.mjs chrome && node scripts/test-background.mjs firefox && npm run smoke
scripts.smoke: node scripts/smoke.mjs chrome && node scripts/smoke.mjs firefox
